name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.
texts: The agent must acquire the yellow key at some point.
The agent reaches the goal square only after it has acquired the key.
The agent reaches the goal square if possible.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 7
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -100.839
